lessonContent.conceptTitle: Touch each one and say the next number!
lessonContent.explanation: Let's count! Touch one picture at a time. Say one number for each picture: one, two, three. The last number you say tells you how many there are.
lessonContent.keyTip: 💡 Tip: Tap each picture only once. The number sticker shows you already counted it!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the stars. Tap each one.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga larawan. Ilan ang mga tala?
exercises.hint: Tap each star, from left to right: one, two, three!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the cans. Tap each one.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga larawan. Ilan ang mga lata sa kahon?
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga lata sa kahon?
exercises.hint: Start with the first can. Tap them one by one: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.

exercises.instructionEn: Count the boxes. Tap each one.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga larawan. Ilan ang mga karton sa kahon?
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga karton sa kahon?
exercises.hint: Tap each box one time and count: one, two, three, four!

titleTl: Pagsasanay A: Piliin ang tamang bilang
subtitle: Multiple Choice Counting (Numbers 10 to 70)

lessonContent.conceptTitle: Count one row, then the next row, then add them!
lessonContent.explanation: When there are many pictures, they sit in rows. First, count the top row. Next, count the row below it. Then put the two numbers together.
lessonContent.keyTip: 💡 Tip: Count row by row, and do not skip any row!

exercises.instructionEn: Count all the yo-yos. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Piliin ang tamang bilang ng mga nasa larawan at isulat ang sagot.
exercises.hint: Row 1 has 9 yo-yos. Row 2 has 3 yo-yos. 9 + 3 = 12.

exercises.instructionEn: Count all the balloons. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Piliin ang tamang bilang ng mga nasa larawan at isulat ang sagot.
exercises.hint: 3 rows have 11 balloons each. That makes 33. The last row has 9 more. 33 + 9 = 42!

exercises.instructionEn: Count all the school bags. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Piliin ang tamang bilang ng mga nasa larawan at isulat ang sagot.
exercises.questionEn: How many school bags are there?
exercises.hint: 4 rows have 13 bags each. That makes 52 bags. The last row has 10 more. 52 + 10 = 62!

titleEn: Activity 3: Count and Choose the Correct Number
titleTl: Gawain 3: Pagbilang at Pagpili ng Tamang Bilang
subtitle: Simple Multiple-Choice Counting Practice for Grade 1

lessonContent.conceptTitle: Count them all, then tap the number that matches!
lessonContent.explanation: First, count all the pictures. You can tap each one to put a number sticker on it. When you know how many there are, tap the number that is the same.
lessonContent.keyTip: 💡 Tip: Count row by row. Then tap the big number that matches!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the strawberries. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga strawberry at piliin ang tamang bilang.
exercises.hint: The top row has 8. The bottom row has 4. 8 + 4 = 12 strawberries.

exercises.instructionEn: Count the pineapples. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga pinya at piliin ang tamang sagot.
exercises.hint: There are 10 rows. Each row has 5 pineapples. Count by fives: 5, 10, 15... all the way to 50!

exercises.instructionEn: Count the apples. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga mansanas at piliin ang tamang sagot.
exercises.hint: There are 7 rows of 10 apples. That makes 70. There is 1 more apple at the bottom. 70 + 1 = 71!

exercises.instructionEn: Count all the strawberries. Then tap the right number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga strawberry sa kahon at piliin ang tamang sagot.
exercises.questionTl: 4. Ilan ang mga strawberry sa kahon?
exercises.hint: The top two rows have 9 + 9 = 18. The last row has 7. 18 + 7 = 25 strawberries.

subtitle: Extra Practice: Quick Counting & Skip Counting

lessonContent.conceptTitle: Count by twos or fives to count faster!
lessonContent.explanation: Skip counting is a fast way to count. Count by twos: 2, 4, 6, 8. Count by fives: 5, 10, 15. We jump over some numbers, so we finish faster!

exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga bulaklak ng dala-dalawa.
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga bulaklak sa hardin?
exercises.hint: There are 2 rows of 8 flowers. 8 + 8 = 16 flowers.

exercises.instructionEn: Count the pencils by fives. Then write the number.
exercises.instructionTl: Bilangin ang mga lapis at isulat ang bilang.
exercises.questionTl: Ilan ang mga lapis sa mesa?
exercises.hint: There are 3 rows of 5 pencils. Count by fives: 5, 10, 15!
